title: Champions of Archery
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: The Champions of Archery are a legendary group of human archers from Eldraine .

The Champions of Archery were created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2019 Heroes of the Realm program. They appear to be a group of at least 5 archers of Embereth who wear the red armor of the court and wield longbows.
